title: Airbnb Superhost rating fragility, worldwide, 2026

field_notes.eligible: listings with at least 10 reviews and a published rating
field_notes.above_superhost: eligible listings with an all-time rating of 4.8 or above
field_notes.buffer_zero: of those above 4.8, how many fall below it on one 1-star review
field_notes.buffer_one_or_less: of those above 4.8, how many fall below it on two
field_notes.median_buffer: median number of 1-star reviews absorbable, among listings above 4.8
field_notes.caveat: All-time ratings. Airbnb assesses Superhost on the trailing 12 months, which public data does not expose.
